'''Silvarte''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] who served the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]].

==Biography==
A [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Human/Legends|Human]], Silvarte was [[Jedi training/Legends|trained]] in the ways of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] by the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], eventually attaining the rank of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]]. Following the [[Great Galactic War]] and the resurgence of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], Master Silvarte returned to the ancestral Jedi homeworld [[Tython/Legends|Tython]] with the rest of the Order and helped rebuild during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], residing at the [[Jedi Temple (Tython)/Legends|Temple]] there. Selecting the young [[Moracen]] as his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]], Master Silvarte and fellow Master [[Yollo]] became suspicious of their students, believing that both Padawans Moracen and [[Spanios]] had begun a romantic relationship. To get an idea of the situation's severity, Master Silvarte sent another Padawan to discover whether the two apprentices were indeed romantically involved.<ref name="Lovers and Secrets" />

While serving as an [[Jedi instructor|instructor]] at the [[Jedi academy|academy]], Master Silvarte would mildly rebuke his students who fought with a clumsy stance during practice, masters of the "Form of the Guid", comparing their [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|lightsaber stance]] similar to the wild [[guid]] that roamed Tython.<ref name="Guid" /> He later authorized [[Devon Race]] to go on an expedition to the ruins of the [[Jedi Tower]] on [[Taris/Legends|Taris]] to recover artifacts.<ref name="Indelicate Operations">{{TORcite|type=faction|Republic|Indelicate Operations|Taris}}</ref>

==Personality==
Silvarte was critical of students who he felt were lax in their training as well as students who didn't completely follow the standard rules of the Jedi. He also appeared to quickly dismiss the latter, since he immediately declared Moracen and Spanios 'wastes' upon learning they started a relationship.<ref name="Lovers and Secrets" />
